name: Rwanda

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes: a wide light blue stripe taking the top half, then yellow and green, with a golden sun of 24 rays in the upper fly.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for happiness and peace, yellow for economic development and green for prosperity; the sun represents enlightenment.

hook: Rwanda shows a golden sun shining in the corner of a big sky-blue band above yellow and green farmland.
trivia: The 2001 flag replaced a red-yellow-green flag with a large black R, which had become associated with the 1994 genocide.
Rwanda has the world's highest share of women in its national parliament, over 60% of lower-house seats.
